description: Updates an existing lead in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

annual_revenue.description: Updated annual revenue. Leave unset to keep unchanged. Negative values are passed through to Salesforce as-is (useful for adjustments/write-offs).
annual_revenue.human_parameter_description: Provide the company's annual revenue as a number. Leave blank to keep the current value.
annual_revenue.title: Annual Revenue

city.description: Updated city. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
city.human_parameter_description: Enter the city for the lead's address. Leave blank to keep it as is.
city.title: City

company.description: Updated company name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
company.human_parameter_description: Enter the lead's company name if it has changed. Leave blank to keep it as is.
company.title: Company

country.description: Updated country. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
country.human_parameter_description: Enter the country for the lead's address. Leave blank to keep it as is.
country.title: Country

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to update on the lead. Pass a dictionary where keys are the Salesforce API names of custom fields (e.g., 'Level__c', 'Languages__c') and values are the field values to set. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Enter custom field values as a JSON object. Use the Salesforce API name for each field (usually ending in '__c'). For example: {"Level__c": "Primary", "Languages__c": "English"}
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

description.description: Updated description. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
description.human_parameter_description: Add any notes or context about this lead, such as follow-up plans. Leave blank to keep the current description.
description.title: Description

email.description: Updated email address. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
email.human_parameter_description: Enter the lead's new email address if it needs updating. Leave blank to keep the existing one.
email.title: Email

first_name.description: Updated first name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
first_name.human_parameter_description: Type the lead's new first name. Leave blank to keep their current first name.
first_name.title: First Name

industry.description: Updated industry. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
industry.human_parameter_description: Enter the industry the company operates in (e.g., Technology, Healthcare). Leave blank to keep it as is.
industry.title: Industry

last_name.description: Updated last name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
last_name.human_parameter_description: Type the lead's new last name. Leave blank to keep their current last name.
last_name.title: Last Name

lead_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the lead to update.
lead_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the Salesforce ID of the lead you want to update. You can copy this from the lead's record URL or from a previous search.
lead_id.title: Lead Id

lead_source.description: Updated lead source. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
lead_source.human_parameter_description: Specify how you acquired this lead (e.g., Web, Phone Inquiry, Referral). Leave blank to keep the current source.
lead_source.title: Lead Source

number_of_employees.description: Updated number of employees. Leave unset to keep unchanged.
number_of_employees.human_parameter_description: Enter how many people work at the company. Leave blank to keep the current value.
number_of_employees.title: Number Of Employees

phone.description: Updated phone number. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
phone.human_parameter_description: Enter the lead's new phone number so you can reach them. Leave blank to keep the current number.
phone.title: Phone

postal_code.description: Updated postal/zip code. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
postal_code.human_parameter_description: Enter the postal or ZIP code for the lead's address. Leave blank to keep it as is.
postal_code.title: Postal Code

rating.description: Updated rating. Leave empty to keep unchanged. Must match a valid picklist value configured in the org; invalid values cause a validation error. Represents lead quality (Hot/Warm/Cold), not pipeline stage.
rating.human_parameter_description: Set the lead's rating (e.g., Hot, Warm, Cold) to reflect priority. Leave blank to keep the current rating.
rating.title: Rating

state.description: Updated state/province. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
state.human_parameter_description: Enter the state or province for the lead's address. Leave blank to keep it as is.
state.title: State

status.description: Updated status. Leave empty to keep unchanged. Must match a valid picklist value configured in the org; invalid values cause a validation error. Represents pipeline stage, not lead quality rating.
status.human_parameter_description: Choose the new status for this lead (e.g., New, Working, Qualified). Leave blank to keep the current status.
status.title: Status

street.description: Updated street address. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
street.human_parameter_description: Enter the street portion of the lead's mailing address. Leave blank to keep it as is.
street.title: Street

title.description: Updated job title. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
title.human_parameter_description: Provide the lead's new job title, such as 'Marketing Manager'. Leave blank to keep the current title.
title.title: Title

website.description: Updated website. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
website.human_parameter_description: Provide the lead's company website URL. Leave blank to keep the current website.
website.title: Website

name: update_lead

SalesforceError.description: Salesforce error object returned when an operation fails.

fields.description: Array of field names that caused the error.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.
message.title: Message

statusCode.description: Salesforce-specific error code (e.g., MALFORMED_ID, INVALID_FIELD, REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED).
statusCode.title: Status Code

SalesforceError.title: SalesforceError

UpdateLeadResponse.description:
Response from updating a Lead record by ID using Salesforce REST API PATCH method.

In API version 46.0 and later, the endpoint returns HTTP 200 OK with a response body
containing id, success, errors, and created fields. In API v45.0 and earlier, it
returns HTTP 204 No Content with an empty response body.

created.description: Indicates whether a new record was created. Always false for PATCH updates (true only for upsert operations that create new records).
created.title: Created

errors.description: Array of error objects. Empty array if the operation was successful.
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The Salesforce record ID of the updated Lead.
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the update operation was successful.
success.title: Success

UpdateLeadResponse.title: UpdateLeadResponse
